name: Founder Operator mission-to-artifact orchestration
acceptanceCriteria: A founder-only Control Room surface converts one mission into a versioned plan containing ULTRATHINK orientation, durable artifact ownership, a first-principles execution slice, verification evidence, and a founder decision gate.
Free-form mission text never becomes a shell command, and execution remains limited to the existing allowlisted local missions.
Plan history is append-only and authenticated persistence writes only to fixed server-owned paths under reports/control-room/founder-operator.

Persistence rejects unknown or inconsistent schemas, normalized private or secret fields, traversal and symlink escapes, unsupported hosted evidence claims, and approval-gated artifacts falsely marked complete.
Merge, deployment, migration, spending, publishing, external-account, credential, and destructive actions remain explicit founder-only gates.

verification.blocker: Require exact-head repository checks and Playwright to execute and pass, then perform a founder-only mission-generation, fixed-path persistence, timeout, and external-action reconciliation rehearsal before promoting beyond contract.
